title: ekl_enroll input
description: Receives the agent's registration once it has announced itself and its publisher has confirmed it.

endpoint.description: The endpoint claimed; must be yours.

authority.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256 of ekl-enroll-1|enrollment_id|nonce|endpoint, keyed with the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the agent key (EKL_AGENT_KEY) as ASCII bytes. Accepted once; may be omitted only for a renewal of the identity the agent holds.

registration_secret.description: Delivered once the claim is authorized: the agent's registration secret.

validation_credential.description: Delivered with it: a credential limited to validation calls.

platform_url.description: The network URL; must equal the one the agent is configured to trust.

receipt_key.description: The receipt key to sign receipts with from now on, sent with every enrollment once the network has rotated it. Without it the agent signs with rk-1, derived from its registration secret.

secret.description: The receipt secret the key derives from.

authority_version.description: 1: authority keyed with the hex SHA-256 of the agent key over ekl-enroll-1|…; 2: keyed with the proof key over ekl-enroll-2|enrollment_id|nonce|endpoint. An agent whose network holds its proof key refuses 1.
